getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:2add6482-950.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies build high-performing teams across executive assistance, administrative support, customer support, sales support, recruiting, operations, and other critical business functions. The Role We’re looking for a hands-on Inside Sales Manager to own the follow-up and mid-funnel layer of our inbound sales engine while raising the quality and consistency of how our entire sales floor sells. You will lead this function, strengthen the systems and processes behind it, coach the team, and ensure every qualified opportunity is managed with discipline and urgency. You will also help establish stronger sales standards across the organization through coaching, performance management, process improvement, and the thoughtful use of sales technology. This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. You will have a team, a modern sales tech stack, and clear revenue and performance targets tied directly to your ownership. responsibilities: What You’ll Own:
Team Leadership
Manage and develop the inbound follow-up team, including SDRs and Sales Associates
Conduct regular 1:1s, coach performance, and hire as the team scales
Own the pairing model between Sales Associates and Account Executives
Establish cadence standards, ownership rules, and CRM hygiene expectations
Manage the Sales Trainer and own onboarding and ramp-up for all new sales hires
Follow-Up and Mid-Funnel Conversion
Design, write, and A/B test follow-up sequences across email and chat
Use reply rate, re-engagement rate, and conversion as your primary scorecards
Build and manage the no-show recovery motion for cancellations and missed demos
Turn missed and cancelled demos into rebooked conversations
Build and run reactivation campaigns for aged and closed-lost opportunities
Reduce stage-to-stage drop-off across the funnel, beginning with the weakest-performing stage
Channel Partner Lead Management
Oversee the handling of leads and opportunities generated through channel partnerships
Establish clear ownership, follow-up, and reporting standards for partner-sourced opportunities
Track channel partner performance and evaluate its effectiveness as a source of new business
Sales Quality and Coaching
Review recorded calls and demos using a written sales scorecard
Maintain a fixed monthly call-review coverage target for every representative
Coach Account Executives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and securing second calls
Run regular calibration sessions to ensure consistent scoring and coaching standards
Join live deals when a representative needs support moving an opportunity forward
Knowledge and Compliance
Own the sales knowledge base as the company’s single source of truth
Maintain the content that powers our AI sales chat assistant
Establish a regular review cadence so customer-facing information remains accurate and current
Ensure claims made by sales representatives and automated channels are accurate and compliant
What You’ll Be Measured On
Demo no-show and cancellation recovery rate
Customer response-time SLA
Deal conversion rate
Sales cycle length
Average contract value per deal
Follow-up reply rate
Touches-per-deal compliance
Second-call booking rate
Stage-to-stage funnel conversion
Demo-to-close rate
Revenue recovered from aged and closed-lost pipeline
Call scorecard coverage, including documented coaching feedback for every representative

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7b8545a8-f337-.title: Data Centre Remote Technical Support Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7b8545a8-f337-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Centre Remote Technical Support Engineer based in India. This is an opportunity to join a technical support environment focused on maintaining reliable, high-performing data centre services for enterprise clients. You will provide Level 2 remote technical support, diagnosing incidents and driving issues through to effective resolution. The role covers a broad infrastructure landscape, including networking, storage, servers, virtualization, backup, security and related data centre technologies. You will work closely with clients, vendors, carriers and internal technical teams to investigate problems and restore services efficiently. Strong attention to SLAs, incident management, documentation and preventative action will be essential to your success. The position offers exposure to enterprise technologies and complex technical environments while strengthening your troubleshooting and support expertise. You will work in a collaborative, customer-focused setting where proactive problem solving and service quality are highly valued. Manage Level 2 remote technical support requests, ensuring incidents and service requests are handled according to established processes, procedures and service-level agreements. Investigate, diagnose and resolve technical incidents using service assurance tools, monitoring platforms, technical documentation and performance data. Prioritize incidents appropriately, identify root causes, implement agreed remedies and preventative measures, and escalate unresolved issues to the relevant technical teams. Provide service recovery and ensure incidents are accurately documented, updated and closed in accordance with operational standards. Monitor service delivery against SLAs, maintain accurate service records and proactively identify opportunities to improve service performance. Perform agreed maintenance activities and use knowledge articles effectively during diagnosis and resolution, contributing updates when required. Maintain accurate and secure configuration information for configuration items, applying appropriate processes to protect infrastructure assets from unauthorized changes. Coordinate repairs, product requests and technical interventions with colleagues, vendors, carriers and other stakeholders to ensure efficient incident resolution. Provide clear and regular communication to clients and affected stakeholders while maintaining accurate updates across ticketing systems, portals and service management tools. Identify recurring problems and potential failures before or as they occur, ensuring incidents are logged with sufficient technical detail for effective investigation and follow-up. Apply specialist knowledge across supported data centre technologies and provide detailed technical guidance where required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Computing or a related technical discipline. Professional-level certifications in data centre technologies are desirable, such as Cisco, NetApp or EMC certifications, including qualifications such as CCNP Data Center or ONTAP. Moderate-level professional experience in technical support, remote data centre support, incident diagnosis and troubleshooting. Hands-on knowledge of networking technologies, including routing, switching, distribution, core and access layers, as well as security and firewall environments. Experience with data centre infrastructure such as storage, backup, computing, server virtualization and related technologies. Working knowledge of call centre routing and Voice over IP technologies is advantageous. Familiarity with management agent concepts, redundancy concepts and remote console architectures within supported technical domains. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7fbaa062-7638-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Analyst, Workday Integrations & Reporting based in United States. This role is a key technical position within an HRIS team responsible for advancing a modern and scalable HR technology environment. You will own and enhance Workday integrations and reporting capabilities that support critical HR, payroll, benefits, finance, and business processes. The position combines hands-on technical delivery with cross-functional partnership, data governance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You will build reliable data flows, develop sophisticated reports and analytics, and ensure information remains accurate, secure, and actionable. Your work will directly support HR operations, compliance, leadership decision-making, and the broader automation of people processes. The role offers significant exposure to technical and business stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. With responsibility for both day-to-day operations and future enhancements, you will help shape the scalability and effectiveness of the HR technology ecosystem. Serve as a technical owner for Workday integrations and reporting, supporting ongoing operations, enhancements, and long-term system optimization. Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot Workday integrations, including inbound and outbound EIBs, Core Connectors, vendor file feeds, and Studio integrations where applicable. Develop and maintain custom Workday reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and analytics to support HR operations, compliance requirements, and leadership decision-making. Partner with HR, IT, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and external providers to ensure reliable data exchange and effective integration performance. Monitor integration activity, investigate errors, and coordinate timely resolution of issues affecting downstream systems and business processes. Participate in Workday release management, regression testing, validation, and change implementation to ensure system stability and continuity. Triage and resolve HRIS requests through ServiceNow while delivering responsive, service-oriented support to internal stakeholders. Strengthen data governance, audit readiness, security, and process efficiency through documentation, controls, system checks, and established reporting standards. Maintain integration documentation, technical build specifications, runbooks, and reporting resources to support scalability and knowledge continuity. Provide consultative guidance and training to HR partners and stakeholders on Workday reporting capabilities, integration impacts, and data considerations. Identify opportunities to improve automation, reporting quality, integration reliability, and overall HR technology processes. Manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment while maintaining strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and delivery timelines. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. At least 8 years of relevant professional experience, including a minimum of 3 years of hands-on Workday integration experience. Strong technical knowledge of Workday reporting capabilities, including Advanced, Matrix, and Composite Reports, calculated fields, dashboards, analytics, and reporting security. Hands-on experience with Workday integration technologies, particularly inbound and outbound EIBs, custom XSLT transformations, Core Connectors, and vendor data feeds. Familiarity with PICOF, PECI, CCW, APIs, and related data exchange methods is preferred. Experience with data security and encryption technologies such as PGP, AS2/X.509, and digital signatures. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b6a85f3c-7bdd-.title: Project Manager, Sample Solutions
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b6a85f3c-7bdd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager, Sample Solutions based in India. As a Project Manager, Sample Solutions, you will manage custom online market research projects from initiation through completion, ensuring quality, timeliness, and accurate execution. You will oversee multiple concurrent projects, coordinating clients, vendors, internal teams, and research activities throughout the project lifecycle. The role combines project management, client service, operational delivery, financial tracking, and risk management. You will play an important part in maintaining strong client relationships through proactive communication and responsive issue resolution. Working in a fast-paced environment, you will manage changing timelines, shifting priorities, and project requirements while maintaining high standards. Your work will directly contribute to client satisfaction, operational efficiency, repeat business, and the successful delivery of research programs. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, analytical, and client-focused professional looking to grow within the market research and consumer insights space. End-to-End Project Management: Manage low-to-mid complexity custom online market research projects across the full lifecycle, including kickoffs, sample and quota setup, survey and screener testing, fieldwork launches, monitoring, quality checks, closeout, and debriefs. Project Delivery: Manage multiple qualitative and quantitative projects simultaneously, ensuring milestones, scope, quality standards, and deadlines are consistently achieved. Client Service: Build professional and collaborative client relationships through regular project updates, clear communication, timely responses, and effective issue resolution. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks throughout fieldwork, monitor project performance, and ensure deliverables meet established standards and requirements. Timeline & Scope Management: Track project milestones, respond effectively to changing deadlines and scope requirements, and maintain project momentum in a dynamic environment. Financial Management: Maintain accurate project records, support revenue forecasting and reconciliations, coordinate invoicing, and track key financial and operational information. Project Metrics: Monitor and report important project metrics, including field times, incidence rates, completion rates, and other indicators of project health. Risk Management: Proactively identify feasibility, timeline, scope, and execution risks, escalating concerns appropriately and recommending practical solutions. Vendor Coordination: Work with approved third-party vendors and outsourcing partners to meet study requirements while monitoring quality, performance, and delivery timelines. Research Operations: Develop and apply knowledge of market research products, panel capabilities, respondent behavior, internal systems, and operational best practices. Complex Projects: Support more specialized research projects, such as in-home usage tests, geofencing, and receipt-capture studies, with appropriate guidance. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work effectively with account teams, internal stakeholders, vendors, and clients to ensure smooth execution and positive project outcomes. Requirements: Experience: 3+ years of relevant project management experience, ideally within market research, consumer insights, or a related field. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; an MBA in Marketing or a related discipline is a plus. Research Knowledge: Understanding of market research and primary research methodologies, with the ability to apply this knowledge to project execution. Position Highlights Highly competitive compensation and sign bonus No call - No nights - No weekends - No holidays Flexible scheduling Independent CRNA practice model High degree of autonomy 4 Rooms PRN Guarantee of 8 hours What You'll Do Provide anesthesia care for outpatient GI procedures Conduct pre-anesthesia evaluations and patient assessments Manage airway and anesthesia administration Monitor patients throughout procedures and recovery Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and support staff Maintain compliance with clinical and safety standards What We Offer Comprehensive benefits package Stable, respected practice Supportive team culture Strong operational support through GI Alliance Qualifications CRNA Eligible state license Excellent communication skills The Specialty Alliance - Powering the future of physician-led, multi-specialty care. Uniting and empowering the nation’s leading physician-led gastroenterology and urology practices through an exclusive alliance built for clinical excellence, growth, and exceptional patient care. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com .
